summary: 10.0.41.06 Restoration of Desktop Rich UI Enhancements (KPI Icon Bubbles & Colorful Table Headers) with Synchronous Frame-0 Rendering
highlights: 1. Restored Colorful KPI Icon Bubbles: Re-enabled KpiCardEnhancer semantic icon bubbles and badges matching Desktop Image 1.
2. Restored Colorful Table Header Pills: Re-enabled TableUiEnhancer semantic badges and icons for all table columns matching Desktop Image 1.
3. Synchronous Frame-0 Enhancement: Eliminated 120ms debounce lag in GlobalUiEnhancer.enhance() so all rich styling is applied synchronously at mount time before first paint.
4. Zero-Flicker Refresh Stability: Guarantees 100% visual identity between dynamic tab navigation and hard browser refresh.
